packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.name: Claude sign-in flow
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.description: Runs Claude Pro/Max OAuth with PKCE: builds the authorize URL, takes a pasted code and exchanges it at the token endpoint.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.name: ChatGPT device-code login
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.description: Runs the ChatGPT device-code sign-in, polling through provider errors until approval, then exchanges the code for tokens.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.name: Sign-in session manager
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.description: Tracks pending subscription sign-ins per user, hands pasted codes across API processes, and saves the finished credential.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.name: Sign-in failure classes
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.description: Reduces a failed sign-in to a fixed reason and class and the plain text shown to the user, never quoting the provider.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.name: Token refresh resolution
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.description: Refreshes a stored OAuth token near expiry, retires dead ones, reads account ids from the JWT, and returns the bearer key.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.name: Run credential store
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.description: Serves a run's OAuth credential to the model library, serializing mid-run refreshes and publishing rotated tokens for saving.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.name: Codex model catalog
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.description: Fetches the models a ChatGPT account may call from the Codex backend and caches the parsed list.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.name: Subscription model exclusions
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.description: Hides Codex models that a ChatGPT subscription sign-in cannot call while leaving them available to API keys.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/pi-runt.name: Runtime model builder
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/pi-runt.description: Builds the model and credential store for a run, passing an API key or the OAuth store to the model library.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/pi-runt.name: Model stream limits
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/pi-runt.description: Defines stream, connect and idle timeouts and tool-result clipping for model calls.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/provider-r.name: Request shape tests
packages/adapters/src/runtime/provider-r.description: Checks the summary of a rejected provider request, including redaction of the bearer and chatgpt-account-id headers.

packages/adapters/src/models/model-secre.name: Stored model secret
packages/adapters/src/models/model-secre.description: Parses and serializes the stored secret as an API key, OAuth credential, reconnect marker or custom endpoint.

packages/adapters/src/models/model-crede.name: Locked credential refresh
packages/adapters/src/models/model-crede.description: Refreshes and rewrites stored OAuth tokens under a database lock, and swaps a dead one for a reconnect marker.

packages/adapters/src/models/model-crede.name: Credential listing
packages/adapters/src/models/model-crede.description: Lists a member's model connections newest first, decrypting each secret and hiding those needing reconnect from runs.

packages/adapters/src/models/model-provi.name: Provider registry
packages/adapters/src/models/model-provi.description: Declares per-provider sign-in mode, labels, key-check URLs, recommended models and deployment keys.

packages/adapters/src/models/model-conne.name: Connect plaintext builder
packages/adapters/src/models/model-conne.description: Builds the plaintext secret saved when a member connects a provider by API key or compatible endpoint.

packages/adapters/src/models/model-conne.name: Connect request check
packages/adapters/src/models/model-conne.description: Sends one minimal agent request at connect time and refuses keys that would fail every run.

packages/adapters/src/billing/plan-limit.name: Plan usage reader
packages/adapters/src/billing/plan-limit.description: Reads Claude and ChatGPT subscription usage windows with the member's own token and caches the readings.

packages/adapters/src/secrets/secrets.ts.name: Encrypted secret store
packages/adapters/src/secrets/secrets.ts.description: Seals secrets with AES-256-GCM using a scrypt key and the record id as authenticated data.

packages/adapters/src/secrets/secret-sto.name: Secret store factory
packages/adapters/src/secrets/secret-sto.description: Selects the encrypted or Infisical secret store from environment settings and holds change notifications.

packages/adapters/src/secrets/key-provid.name: Key provider factory
packages/adapters/src/secrets/key-provid.description: Chooses local master keys or AWS KMS to wrap keys and unwraps wrapped environment values at startup.

packages/adapters/src/locks/refresh-lock.name: Refresh lock
packages/adapters/src/locks/refresh-lock.description: Runs a transaction under an advisory lock so one rotating credential is refreshed by one process at a time.

packages/adapters/src/providers/cli-mode.name: Claude Code provider
packages/adapters/src/providers/cli-mode.description: Runs model turns through the user's own signed-in Claude Code CLI on a personal self-hosted server.

packages/adapters/src/cli-models/persona.name: Personal CLI runtime
packages/adapters/src/cli-models/persona.description: Registers the official CLI providers that run only for a single-account self-hosted server.

apps/api/src/routes/models.ts.name: Models API routes
apps/api/src/routes/models.ts.description: Serves model connect, sign-in begin, submit, complete, finish, cancel and disconnect procedures.

apps/api/src/models/model-credentials.ts.name: Model connection saving
apps/api/src/models/model-credentials.ts.description: Verifies an API-key connection, encrypts it and saves the credential with its default model.

apps/api/src/routes/content.ts.name: Content API routes
apps/api/src/routes/content.ts.description: Serves usage routes, including subscription plan limits that trigger a background token refresh.

packages/contracts/src/models/model-prov.name: Provider contract helpers
packages/contracts/src/models/model-prov.description: Holds the sign-in expired text, API-key character check and provider id normalization.

packages/core/src/models/model-oauth.ts.name: OAuth client polling
packages/core/src/models/model-oauth.ts.description: Polls the server for sign-in completion and stops at the code's expiry plus a grace margin.

packages/core/src/models/model-providers.name: Provider display helpers
packages/core/src/models/model-providers.description: Lists subscription names and orders popular providers first, with thinking-level clamping.

packages/core/src/runs/run-error.ts.name: Run error classifier
packages/core/src/runs/run-error.ts.description: Sorts provider failures into auth, access, rate, credit and context kinds with fixed user text.

apps/web/src/lib/models/use-model-oauth-.name: Web sign-in hook
apps/web/src/lib/models/use-model-oauth-.description: Starts a subscription sign-in, captures the desktop callback or pasted code, and waits for the save.

apps/web/src/lib/models/model-auth.ts.name: Web sign-in waiter
apps/web/src/lib/models/model-auth.ts.description: Wraps the shared completion poller around the completeOAuth call for the web client.

apps/web/src/components/models/Subscript.name: Sign-in steps card
apps/web/src/components/models/Subscript.description: Shows the setup, device code or paste-code steps for a subscription sign-in.

apps/web/src/lib/platform/desktop.ts.name: Desktop bridge helpers
apps/web/src/lib/platform/desktop.ts.description: Reads the OAuth state and forwards desktop loopback callbacks to the sign-in hook.

apps/desktop/src/main/auth/browser-auth..name: Desktop browser auth
apps/desktop/src/main/auth/browser-auth..description: Opens the sign-in page and listens on a loopback port to capture the OAuth redirect code.

apps/desktop/src/main/auth/oauth-callbac.name: Desktop callback parser
apps/desktop/src/main/auth/oauth-callbac.description: Extracts the code and state from loopback redirect URLs for sign-in and MCP flows.

apps/mobile/lib/auth/use-subscription-si.name: Mobile sign-in hook
apps/mobile/lib/auth/use-subscription-si.description: Starts a subscription sign-in on mobile with the code page, copies the code and opens the link.
